name: Count Occurrences
description: Counts how many times each element appears in an array using a hash map (frequency table).
aim: Build a frequency map: for each element, count how many times it appears in the input array.
howItWorks: For each element: map[element]++ (or initialize to 1)

complexity.spaceDescription: k distinct values in the map

alternatives: Sorting + count — O(n log n) but no extra space
